partially_covered.missing: Organization attributes remain limited: no explicit properties for contact details, legal identifiers, warehouse addresses, or additional EN 16931-1 attributes. Only generic Address and Identifier classes exist.
No OWL restrictions or SHACL shapes for mandatory fields (e.g., invoice number, buyer identifier, address). Ontology still lacks explicit validation constraints for file format compliance.

cq_coverage.details: Coverage remains strong for most CQs, but organization attribute completeness and file format validation are still only partially addressed. No new CQs were missed; same gaps as previous iteration.

strengths: Deep and well-structured class hierarchy reflecting EDIFACT message architecture
Functional properties and inverse properties defined
Disjointness axioms present for key classes
weaknesses: No OWL restrictions (minCardinality, allValuesFrom) or SHACL shapes for mandatory field enforcement
No General Class Axioms (GCAs) or equivalence axioms for complex class definitions

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4: Missing domain/range constraints on some properties (but most are defined)
P7: No explicit validation for mandatory fields

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Model additional organization attributes: add properties for contact details (email, phone), legal identifiers (VAT, company registration), and warehouse addresses. Expand Address and Identifier subclasses to support EN 16931-1 requirements.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improved coverage for CQ5; more expressive and compliant organization representation.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add OWL restrictions (minCardinality, allValuesFrom) or SHACL shapes to enforce mandatory fields (e.g., Invoice must have invoice number, buyer, and address).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Better coverage for CQ13; improved validator compatibility and semantic interoperability.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce GCAs and equivalence axioms for key classes (e.g., Invoice = intersection of header, detail, summary; OrganizationRoleAssignment = Organization + AgentRole).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Richer logical structure; improved reasoning and query capabilities.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand business process modeling and add granular segment/element classes for deeper EDIFACT alignment.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Greater expressiveness and alignment with EN 16931-1 and P2P-O standards.

summary: The ontology remains robust in structural coverage and answers most competency questions, but has not progressed on critical improvements from the previous review. Mandatory field enforcement and detailed organization attribute modeling are still missing, limiting semantic validation and compliance. Advanced OWL constructs and richer axiomatization are recommended for next iteration.

suggestions_ignored: Add explicit properties for organization attributes such as contact details, legal identifiers, and warehouse addresses
Introduce OWL restrictions or SHACL shapes for mandatory fields
Add GCAs and equivalence axioms for key classes
improvement_tracking.notes: No substantive changes were made since the last iteration; the ontology remains static in quality and coverage. Previous critical suggestions for CQ5 and CQ13 were not addressed. No new issues were introduced, but critical gaps persist.
